# watchpoint_sla_profile (Resource)

An SLA profile defining uptime/latency/error-rate targets over a rolling window. Requires the `sla_monitoring` feature (Business tier).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_sla_profile" "example" {
  name                  = "Production tier 1"
  target_uptime_percent = 99.9
  window_days           = 30
  target_p95_latency_ms = 500
  alert_on_breach       = true
  alert_profile_id      = "ap_001"
}

# A telemetry SLO: the share of checkout requests that succeeded, read from two
# OTLP metrics. Gets the same multi-window burn-rate alerts as monitor SLOs.
resource "watchpoint_sla_profile" "checkout_success" {
  name                  = "Checkout success rate"
  target_uptime_percent = 99.5
  window_days           = 28
  source_kind           = "Metrics"
  source_config_json = jsonencode({
    goodMetric  = "checkout.requests.ok"
    totalMetric = "checkout.requests"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable profile name.
- `target_uptime_percent` (Number) Target uptime percentage in the range (0, 100].
- `window_days` (Number) Rolling evaluation window in days (1-365).

### Optional

- `alert_on_at_risk` (Boolean) Raise an alert when the SLA becomes at-risk. Defaults to `false`.
- `alert_on_breach` (Boolean) Raise an alert when the SLA is breached. Defaults to `true`.
- `alert_profile_id` (String) Alert profile used for SLA notifications.
- `at_risk_threshold_percent` (Number) Error-budget consumption (percent) at which the SLA is flagged at-risk. Defaults to `75`.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `exclude_maintenance_windows` (Boolean) Exclude scheduled maintenance windows from SLA calculations. Defaults to `true`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default SLA profile. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_error_rate_percent` (Number) Optional maximum allowed error rate percentage.
- `source_config_json` (String) JSON configuration for a telemetry source; not allowed with `Monitor`. `Traces`: `{"serviceName":"checkout","operationName":"POST /pay","objectiveMs":300}` (operation and objective optional). `Metrics`: `{"goodMetric":"http.requests.ok","totalMetric":"http.requests"}`, both required. Use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `source_kind` (String) Where attainment comes from. `Monitor` (default) scores the monitors and groups attached to the profile. `Traces` scores an OTLP service or operation from its spans (error rate, and latency against an objective); `Metrics` scores the ratio of two OTLP metrics, good over total. Telemetry sources are not attached to monitors and get the same multi-window burn-rate alerts as monitor SLOs. Both require the `slo_trace_source` feature.
- `target_p95_latency_ms` (Number) Optional p95 latency target in milliseconds.

### Read-Only

- `attached_count` (Number) Number of monitors and groups attached to this profile.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) SLA profile ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_sla_profile.example sla_001
```
